statements.impact_statement: patches/0001 removes the unsigned-trailer upload mode (X-Amz-Content-Sha256: STREAMING-UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD-TRAILER) from the accepted S3 authentication types; such requests are refused with HTTP 400 InvalidRequest before authentication or any S3 handler runs.

statements.impact_statement: Requires OpenID Connect identity to be configured. The chart configures only the root credentials; do not enable OIDC on this MinIO.
Requires LDAP identity to be configured. The chart configures only the root credentials; do not enable LDAP on this MinIO.
The internode storage API (ReadMultiple) is registered only in distributed, multi-node mode. The chart runs a single node (minio server /data).
